description: This is the fixed BASELINE snapshot of ratchet.py's visible CLI/hook behavior, captured from real invocations before any code in this run has moved. Every later checkpoint in this run (CP2..CP8) re-captures the same commands and must match this snapshot byte-identically (--help text, status --json's top-level keys/shape, the hook reply shape, and the exit codes for known failures). Later checkpoints' tests diff/compare their own fresh capture against this baseline; nothing here changes once a later checkpoint starts moving code.
note: This manifest lives at tests/fixtures/modularize_cp1/baseline/manifest.json; every 'path' field below is relative to that same tests/fixtures/modularize_cp1/baseline folder.
captured_from: the real, active run in this working tree (behavior-preserving-modularization-of-skills-rat), before any code change to ratchet.py/provider_health.py/spec_sources.py (see CP1-T10's git-diff-clean check)

entries.note: Captured from this run's own active state (the run that is implementing this very checkpoint).

A real PreToolUse 'guard' hook reply from a throwaway temp project (built with the real `init` command), fed a copilot-dialect payload that edits that project's own state.json directly (the same tamper attempt tests/test_hooks.py uses). Nothing in the real repo's own .ratchet/ was touched to capture this.
